install -d -m 0755 /opt/inventory cat > /opt/inventory/app.py <<'PYEOF' #!/usr/bin/python3 import json import socket from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer HOST = socket.gethostname().split(".")[0] ITEMS = [ {"sku": "LAPTOP-001", "name": "Developer Laptop", "quantity": 12}, {"sku": "MONITOR-024", "name": "24-inch Monitor", "quantity": 28}, {"sku": "KEYBOARD-USB", "name": "USB Keyboard", "quantity": 41}, ] class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def send_body(self, body, content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8", status=200): payload = body.encode() self.send_response(status) self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type) self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload))) self.send_header("X-Backend-Node", HOST) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(payload) def do_GET(self): if self.path == "/health": self.send_body(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "backend": HOST}) + "\n", "application/json") elif self.path == "/api/inventory": self.send_body(json.dumps({"backend": HOST, "items": ITEMS}) + "\n", "application/json") elif self.path == "/": rows = "".join(f"{i['sku']}{i['name']}{i['quantity']}" for i in ITEMS) page = f"Inventory

Inventory

Served by {HOST}

{rows}
SKUItemQuantity
\n" self.send_body(page, "text/html; charset=utf-8") else: self.send_body("not found\n", status=404) def log_message(self, fmt, *args): print(f"{self.address_string()} - {fmt % args}", flush=True) ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever() PYEOF chmod 0755 /opt/inventory/app.py cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory.service <<'UNITEOF' [Unit] Description=Inventory web application After=network-online.target Wants=network-online.target [Service] Type=simple User=nobody Group=nobody ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory/app.py Restart=always RestartSec=2 NoNewPrivileges=true PrivateTmp=true ProtectSystem=strict ProtectHome=true [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target UNITEOF systemctl daemon-reload systemctl enable --now inventory.service firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp
